note: Evaluation examples, not a list of allowed questions. Run on the synthetic fixture by tests/run_live.sh. Checks catch clear failures; a person still reads each transcript in results/live_eval.json.

turns.q: How many goals did we score in our last five practices?
What was our goals per 100 shots in opponent scrimmages this season?
turns.golden: (() => { const l = SHOTS.filter(s => s.team !== 'OPP' && s.shooterJersey && seasonForDate(s.date) === currentAdvSeason() && sessionTypeOf(s) === 'Opponent scrimmage'); return Math.round(1000 * l.filter(s => s.goal === 1).length / l.length) / 10; })()

turns.q: And in practices?
turns.golden: (() => { const l = SHOTS.filter(s => s.team !== 'OPP' && s.shooterJersey && seasonForDate(s.date) === currentAdvSeason() && sessionTypeOf(s) === 'Practice'); return Math.round(1000 * l.filter(s => s.goal === 1).length / l.length) / 10; })()

turns.q: Who scored the most goals in practice this season?
turns.golden_name: (() => { const by = {}; SHOTS.filter(s => s.team !== 'OPP' && s.goal === 1 && s.shooterJersey && seasonForDate(s.date) === currentAdvSeason() && sessionTypeOf(s) === 'Practice').forEach(s => { by[s.shooterJersey] = (by[s.shooterJersey] || 0) + 1; }); const top = Math.max(...Object.values(by)); return Object.keys(by).filter(j => by[j] === top).map(j => lastNameOf(nameFor(j, currentAdvSeason()))); })()
